findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 section(s) have content at both edges and 11542px of nothing between: "BDE EMSI"; "Pitch de minuit — concours startup"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Pitch de minuit — concours startup"; "Cinéma en plein air : classiques marocains"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Little motion: 12 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: The margins differ: 16px on the left, 33px on the right, at 768px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 361px of the width empty: "Un campus, compté.".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
